notes.title: New GreatherGames Release - Sept 20th
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

Got a new game coming out soon, so just letting you all know! 

This new release is called Sir'HaXXX, a 2D adult shooter, which i think you will enjoy!

In Sir'HaXXX you are attempting to "hack data", which is presented in this 2D Shooter form. You must destroy threats, which will then give you data, allowing you to access the adult gallery. 

You will encounter various enemies, collect power ups, unlock achievements and enjoy some nice adult audio responses as you play!

You can check out the store page here for more details - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151840/SirHaXXX/

[i]Does this mean you are finished with Hyper Mum Ft Adult Gaming?[/i]
Not at all, just letting you know about the new game :)

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Released
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34552531/c46b2d8d2b3aa10ab04f5d6d8fa1a035abc773a6.png[/img]

Hello!

Here it is, update 1.1

I hope you all enjoy the new content, i added this bit of extra content due to recent feedback.

Virtual Girlfriend in-game game is now available, along with a new gallery once you unlock it, with two additional achievements. Adding additional achievements is not something i continually plan to do as i understand how having to go back and replay a game you already got 100% on could be bothersome. 

Any feedback regarding this is appreciated.

As before, you will need to make sure your mum doesn't catch you, I also advise you make sure that your actual mum also doesn't walk in!

Along with this content update, the UI as been tweaked and a few minor bugs have been fixed. The "MUM CAM" as been slightly changed to simulate someone actually walking around, adding motion to the camera.

Your opinion on the new content is also appreciated, don't like it? or would like to see more new content like this?

If you run into any problems, please do let me know.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello there,

I thought it would be best to post an announcement, let you all know what is going on.

I have been taking in recent feedback and as such decided a new content update was in order. 

Along with this new content, some new achievements are being added, so you may notice additional achievements appear, but be invisible. This is for testing purposes for the new content.

[i]When is the new update?[/i]
It is near enough ready, so you will see it released anytime over the next couple of days. As soon as everything as been tested.

Thanks for reading.

notes.title: Release Date - March 4th
notes.notes:
Hello there!
